# International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)

> The IAEA is the UN's global hub for peaceful nuclear technology, safety, security, and sustainable development across energy, health, agriculture, and environmental applications.

The IAEA promotes the safe, secure, and peaceful use of nuclear science and technology while providing technical assistance to 173 member states. The organization operates from Vienna headquarters with regional offices worldwide, advancing nuclear solutions for climate change mitigation, food security, healthcare, and industrial innovation.

## Key Topics

- Nuclear Safety and Security
- Peaceful Use of Nuclear Technology
- Nuclear Energy and Power
- Safeguards and Non-Proliferation
- Radioactive Waste Management
- Nuclear Medicine and Health Applications
- Food and Agriculture
- Climate Change Mitigation
- Radiation Protection
- Isotopic Techniques
- Water Resource Management
- Industrial Applications
- Member States Technical Assistance
- Director-General Leadership
- Sustainable Development

## Core Resources

- [International Atomic Energy Agency | Atoms for Peace and Development](https://www.iaea.org): IAEA homepage promoting safe, secure, peaceful nuclear technology use
- [Topics | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics): IAEA topic hub covering nuclear technology, safety, security, and applications

## Nuclear Safety and Security

- [Nuclear safety and security | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-safety-and-security): IAEA global nuclear safety and security framework for radiation protection

## Nuclear Technology and Applications

- [Nuclear technology and applications | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-technology-and-applications): IAEA assistance in peaceful nuclear science and technology transfer to members
- [Nuclear energy, safe use of nuclear power | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/energy): Nuclear energy for clean, reliable power and climate change mitigation
- [Nuclear science | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-science): IAEA nuclear science, research, and technical assistance to member states

## Health, Food, and Agriculture

- [Health care and diagnostics, nuclear medicine | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/health): Nuclear medicine techniques for cancer treatment and health diagnostics
- [Nuclear technologies for food and agriculture | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/food-and-agriculture): IAEA-FAO partnership on nuclear agriculture for food security and safety

## Environment and Climate

- [Studying climate change with nuclear and isotopic techniques | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/climate-change): IAEA nuclear science tools for climate monitoring and emissions mitigation
- [Environment | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/environment): Nuclear and isotopic tools for environmental protection and remediation
- [Water: quality and availability assessment with isotopic techniques | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/water): Isotope hydrology for water security, quality, and resource management
- [Nuclear science and technology for industry | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/industry): Industrial radiation technologies for innovation, safety, and efficiency

## Media and Communications
